details.jobDescription:
ALTEN Romania is part of the ALTEN Group, Leader in IT and Engineering Consulting. We develop innovative and durable technical solutions that fulfil the needs of our local and international partners.︁︀​︂︀︀​︁︂︉​︇︉


Requirements:
  • Minimum 2 years of experience working with Mainframe technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of COBOL.
  • Experience with CICS, JCL, and preferably DB2.
  • Advanced SQL knowledge.
  • Understanding of application maintenance and production support activities.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good English skills.
  • Good French skills.


*Only eligible candidates will be contacted in a maximum of 2 weeks. Any information provided is treated as confidential.
About the role:
We are seeking for skilled Mainframe COBOL/CICS/JCL developer who will be responsible for the maintenance and implementation of corrective and evolution changes of a financial product (banking, insurance) for our customers in Financial Services industry.


Responsibilities:
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance mainframe applications based on business and technical requirements.
  • Implement corrective fixes and evolutionary changes for existing financial products.
  • Analyze incidents, troubleshoot issues, and provide sustainable solutions.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, testers, and technical teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Ensure code quality, performance, and compliance with project standards.

ALTEN Romania, part of the international ALTEN Group - with a unique position as Leader in IT & Engineering Consulting, provides support for its clients’ development strategies in the fields of innovation, R&D and IT systems since 1996. The company comprises 2 divisions specialized on its core capabilities: ENGINEERING and IT.

ALTEN Romania has a team of over 500 consultants that work on ambitious projects from offices in Bucharest, Timisoara, Sibiu, Cluj-Napoca, Pitesti, Craiova.

ALTEN IT division offers software development services, business and technical analysis, support, maintenance and monitoring for national & international clients. 310 consultants from 3 cities (Bucharest, Pitesti, Craiova) are working on ambitious projects for leading global companies in banking, telecommunications and services sectors.

The IT Division has a team of consultants who are specifically specialized in Java, .NET, PHP, C#, C++, Siebel, Cognos, MS BI and Oracle BI, BSCS, PMP.

ALTEN Engineering division provides services in different sectors such as automotive, aeronautics, railways and energy with a team of 160 engineers from 4 cities (Bucharest, Timisoara, Sibiu, Cluj Napoca). Our consultants deliver innovative solutions for our customers, being specifically specialized in CATIA V5, NewPDM, SolidWorks, Matlab/ Simulink, HIL, Embedded Systems.
